core_obligations: Identify the local ring at x with the local ring of the residual space at its unique point.
The codimension is the length of chains of irreducible closed subsets through the point; chains in X through x correspond bijectively to chains in the residual space.
proof_roadmap: Local ring identification; chain bijection; equality.
difficulty_reason: A chain-correspondence argument; the identification step is the substance.
